correctness.rationale: At threshold the source Lyapunov function has the exact derivative \(-\mu_A A(A+N+L)/(K+A+N+L)\), and the largest invariant subset of its zero set is only the origin, proving global convergence and Lyapunov stability. The Jacobian has a simple zero eigenvalue and a Hurwitz cubic complement. Fresh symbolic multiplication verified the stated positive right and left zero eigenvectors and \(\ell^Tr=\beta H\). With \(z=p^Tx\), the exact identity \(\dot z=-AS/[H(K+S)]\) and positivity give quadratic forcing of the exponentially stable complement, hence \(x=zr+o(z)\). Therefore \(\dot z=-(C/(KH))z^2(1+o(1))\), which yields the claimed \(t^{-1}\) vector.

limitations: The theorem is for the deterministic uncontrolled four-stage model with the exact source recruitment law.
